information: All Standards-Based Math Assessment Data for Public Schools

Beginning in 2019, the data provided in this updated file format includes assessment data available to the public for both MCA-III and MTAS-III tests, labeled as "All Standards-Based (MCA/MTAS/ALTMCA)" in the "Test Name" column. Previously, public assessment data was available as separate individual files by test name. Assessment data are provided for the state, district, school, and county levels (data at the charter authorizer level will be added in the near future). Select the relevant tab in the spreadsheet to access data for each level. There is a column definitions tab in each Excel file that provides an explanation of the content and fields in the file.
Please refer to the User Guide for more information.
If you have needs for assessment data not provided in this file, please email mde.analytics@state.mn.us.

information: All enrollment counts provided are based on the October 1 enrollment reported to MDE. The data provided in this file combines the previous Gender/Ethnicity and Special Populations files into one report. Data are provided for the state, district, school and county levels. To see data at each of these levels, click the tab at the bottom of the spreadsheet. The column definitions tab provides an explanation of what data are displayed in the file.

Student Privacy Note: The Minnesota Department of Education (MDE) is now implementing privacy protection rules in the enrollment data. Within the file, any blank cell is one that cannot be reported due to these rules and you can get more specific information about why using the column definitions. MDE has historically implemented primary suppression in public reporting. For most reports, this meant that if there was a student group with fewer than 10 students, the data was not reported. MDE is now implementing primary suppression, complementary suppression, and data blurring rules to further protect student privacy in compliance with federal and state guidelines.

Student Identification: The Minnesota Department of Education (MDE) is now reporting students using eight state-defined racial and ethnic groups, including the use of the state definition of American Indian and the new Other Indigenous group. The tabs labeled “State,” “County,” “District,” and “School” report students using these groups. In these tabs, students count as American Indian if they meet the state definition regardless of any other racial or ethnic groups with which they may have identified. The state of Minnesota’s definition of American Indian includes any of the original people within what is now the borders of the United States (excluding Hawaii) or Canada who maintain cultural identification through tribal affiliation or community recognition. This is different from the federal definition of American Indian or Alaska Native which includes students whose only racial or ethnic identification is with the original peoples of North, Central, or South America. Within the eight state racial or ethnic groups, the new Other Indigenous group includes students who meet the federal definition of American Indian or Alaska Native but not the state definition of American Indian, which means they identify only with indigenous peoples from Central and South America. The “State-Federal,” “County-Federal,” “District-Federal,” and “School-Federal” tabs report students following federal guidance. All tabs include students attending Tribally Controlled Schools for the first time for the 24-25 Data/School Year.
For more information, please see our Privacy Protection Rules documentation.
If you have needs for enrollment data not provided in this file, please email mde.analytics@state.mn.us.
